entries.title: Genesis 20:1
segments: ¶And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country, and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur, and sojourned in Gerar.

entries.title: Genesis 20:2
segments: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She [is] my sister: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

entries.title: Genesis 20:3
segments: ¶But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou [art but] a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she [is] a man's wife. {a man's...: Heb. married to an husband}

words.text: to him, Behold, thou [art but] a dead man
. {a man's...: Heb. married to an husband}

entries.title: Genesis 20:4
segments: But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?

entries.title: Genesis 20:5
segments: Said he not unto me, She [is] my sister? and she, even she herself said, He [is] my brother: in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this. {integrity: or, simplicity, or, sincerity}

entries.title: Genesis 20:6
segments: And God said unto him in a dream, Yea, I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me: therefore suffered I thee not to touch her.

entries.title: Genesis 20:7
segments: Now therefore restore the man [his] wife; for he [is] a prophet, and he shall pray for thee, and thou shalt live: and if thou restore [her] not, know thou that thou shalt surely die, thou, and all that [are] thine.

entries.title: Genesis 20:8
segments: ¶Therefore Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ears: and the men were sore afraid.

entries.title: Genesis 20:9
segments: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said unto him, What hast thou done unto us? and what have I offended thee, that thou hast brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? thou hast done deeds unto me that ought not to be done.

unto me that ought not to be done

entries.title: Genesis 20:10
segments: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?

entries.title: Genesis 20:11
segments: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God [is] not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.

entries.title: Genesis 20:12
segments: And yet indeed [she is] my sister; she [is] the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

entries.title: Genesis 20:13
segments: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father's house, that I said unto her, This [is] thy kindness which thou shalt shew unto me; at every place whither we shall come, say of me, He [is] my brother.

entries.title: Genesis 20:14
segments: ¶And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave [them] unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 20:15
segments: And Abimelech said, Behold, my land [is] before thee: dwell where it pleaseth thee. {where...: Heb. as is good in thine eyes}

words.text: thee. {where...: Heb. as is good in thine eyes}

entries.title: Genesis 20:16
segments: And unto Sarah he said, Behold, I have given thy brother a thousand [pieces] of silver: behold, he [is] to thee a covering of the eyes, unto all that [are] with thee, and with all [other]: thus she was reproved.

entries.title: Genesis 20:17
segments: So Abraham prayed unto God: and God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his maidservants; and they bare [children].

entries.title: Genesis 20:18
segments: For the LORD had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah Abraham's wife.
